title: Ordinary small pro-etale tensor, pure sections and canonical total pullback comparison
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism. Use the small pro-etale module categories and the identified-coefficient module pullback $F=f_R^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], for commutative ring sheaves $R$ on $Y$ and $S$ on $X$ and a fixed $c:f^{-1}R\simeq S$. The ordinary tensor bifunctor is the existing sheafified tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its pure-section pairing sends $(m,n)$ over an object $U$ to the sheafification image of $m\otimes_{R(U)}n$. Define the canonical natural isomorphism $\mu_{M,N}:F(M\otimes_R N)\simeq FM\otimes_S FN$ by the unique unit-section normalization sending the inverse-image unit of $m\otimes n$ to the tensor of the two inverse-image unit sections, for every site object and all its sections. For arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes $P,Q$, use the signed direct-sum total tensor of [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Define $\kappa_{P,Q}:\operatorname{Tot}(FP\otimes_S FQ)\simeq F\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes_R Q)$ by summing $\mu_{P^p,Q^q}^{-1}$ in every bidegree and the canonical preservation-of-coproducts comparison. This fixes its direction and every summand map, with the usual total differential signs; it is not a choice of an arbitrary chain isomorphism. No boundedness, flatness or K-flatness is imposed.

proof.text: Instantiate the existing independently sized normalized ringed tensor comparison with the unit-normalized pro-etale algebraic inverse image and the displayed coefficient extension. This supplies its scalar insertion q and its natural isomorphisms mu, with the full generalized pure-tensor formula.

Apply the generalized pure formula to the product of the two underlying module sheaves, its two projections, and the sheafified pure tensor map. Evaluate at the set-inverse-image unit of (m,n). Naturality of the unit and the normalized algebraic lift identify the resulting inverse-image sections. The scalar insertion formula and the normalized module adjunction identify q of those sections with the prescribed module unit. This gives the required section formula.

For uniqueness, transpose the two candidate hom maps through the specified module adjunction. Their transposes agree on all pure sections by the required formula; the sheafification adjunction and sectionwise tensor induction imply equality. Iso.ext and function extensionality finish. The existing signed total construction and its invertibility theorem then produce the stipulated total isomorphism.
